name: Modern
note: The Modern system: one deep-ocean ink on cream, Newsreader light, tracked labels, flat square panels and pills, after a reference proposal deck.
signature: Deep-ocean #1f4558 on cream, Newsreader 300 and square panels with pill buttons.

name: Northlight
note: Layers of porcelain and pearl whites lit by the Northlight sun: glass panels with 22 px corners, Newsreader and tracked Jost after Solage, a fine sun-gradient ring on the primary action, the open view raised on layered soft shadows, an edge glow that breathes and swells when the OS acts, and a faint aura that follows the cursor. Night mode is the logo’s violet sky.
signature: Soft white glass and a sun-gradient hairline (#ebc913 → #e77103 → #dc3286 → #8f6ab7 → #8bb1d3), with ambient light at the edges.

name: Aman
note: Sand paper ground, warm charcoal ink, regular-weight serif and square outline buttons with wide padding; bronze only on hover.
signature: The #f3eee7 sand ground with square 1px outline buttons padded 4em wide.

name: Six Senses
note: White and linen grounds, a deep plum accent, a humanist serif set slightly tight, and plum pill buttons on 10 px panels.
signature: Plum #673065 pill buttons with a serif tracked -0.02em.

name: The Well
note: One cocoa brown used at every strength for ink, lines and washes, an extra-light display serif, and tracked uppercase labels on blush linen.
signature: A single brown, #4d362b, carried by opacity, with a weight-200 display serif.

name: Remedy Place
note: Nocturnal: black ground, bone type, a muted champagne gold and 20 %-alpha warm hairlines; tiny labels tracked very wide, square outlined buttons.
signature: Black ground, #b9b2aa33 hairlines and labels tracked 0.22em. Best in dark.

name: Golden Door
note: Heritage ranch spa: inscriptional Roman capitals in gold, warm browns on cream, thin near-square gold buttons and slow one-second fades.
signature: Inscriptional capitals (Cinzel for Trajan) with gold #c9a555.

name: Kamalaya
note: A tropical sanctuary led by photography: white ground, charcoal text, lotus burgundy and saffron, all-caps headings tracked very wide, square buttons.
signature: Uppercase headings tracked about 0.19em with square burgundy #822127 buttons.

name: Solage
note: Relaxed wine country: white ground, grey-brown text, a light serif for headlines and body, and a filled butter-gold button in bold tracked capitals.
signature: A filled butter-gold #e6cf87 button with bold caps tracked 2 px.

name: Lanserhof
note: Cool clinical neutrals with no color accent: slate greys, a light italic serif beside an upright sans, compact pill buttons and frosted navigation.
signature: A light italic serif headline on cool slate neutrals.

name: SHA
note: Swiss-medical precision: one light sans in uppercase headlines, white and cool-grey grounds, a near-black navy, thin outline buttons, and the most motion of the set.
signature: Light uppercase sans with no accent color; motion carries the identity.

name: Chenot
note: Lakeside clinical luxury: warm white and blush grounds, black type, a pale sand accent, wide-tracked geometric capitals and 36 px pill buttons.
signature: 36 px pills and uppercase headings tracked 0.06em on warm white.
